mil5.2.7:0.4: 7. Question on Looking After the Community of Bhikkhus
mil5.2.7:1.1: “Venerable Nāgasena, this too was said by the Blessed One:
mil5.2.7:1.2: ‘Ānanda, it does not occur to the Tathāgata, “I will look after the community of bhikkhus,” or “The community of bhikkhus is under my direction.”’
mil5.2.7:1.3: Yet in describing the natural qualities of the Blessed One Metteyya, the Blessed One also said:
mil5.2.7:1.4: ‘He will look after a community of many thousands of bhikkhus, just as I now look after a community of many hundreds of bhikkhus.’
